beats.say: In 1925, a con man sold the Eiffel Tower.
He read in the paper that the tower cost a fortune to repair.
So he pretended to be a government official, and invited scrap metal dealers to a secret meeting.
He told them Paris was tearing the tower down, and selling it for scrap.
One dealer paid him, for over 7,000 tons of iron.
Lustig ran off with the money, and the dealer was too embarrassed to tell the police.
So Lustig came back… and tried to sell it again.
